args.body: Take LWN-TECHNICAL-PROPOSAL-TEST after checking equivalent work and claiming its actual lease. The prior two-publisher STOP establishes unread source terms only. This test must reach a concrete truthful proposal when official evidence supports preparation, rather than generating article inventory or another general market scan. Stop within the three-source bound. No contact is authorized. Five unclassified feedback sources mean unknown demand; funding and revenue remain unverified. Preserve all deadlines and retirements.

description: The latest writing experiment stopped because both source requests were refused; it did not establish that paid publishing rejects AI work. Feedback is AVAILABLE but has five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Test one distinct publisher with accessible official terms before preparing a proposal. Verified funds and revenue remain zero; existing experiments and retirement deadlines continue.
